30184.commentary: (MNa) tajjaṃ tassāruppan'ti tajjātikaṃ tadanucchavikaṃ, pañcannaṃ verānaṃ diṭṭhadhammaka-samparāyika-ādīnava-ppaṭisaṃyuttan'ti adhippāyo.

examples.text: accāraddhamhi vīriyamhi, satthā loke anuttaro, vīṇ'opamaṃ karitvā me, dhammaṃ desesi cakkhumā, tass'āhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā, vihāsiṃ sāsane rato.
eso hi bhagavā buddho, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ pati, sabbadukkhappahānāya, dhammaṃ deseti pāṇinaṃ, tass'āhaṃ santikaṃ gacchaṃ, so me satthā bhavissati.
tass'imāni satta ratanāni bhavanti, seyyath'idaṃ, cakkaratanaṃ, hatthiratanaṃ, assaratanaṃ, maṇiratanaṃ, itthiratanaṃ, gahapatiratanaṃ, pariṇāyakaratanam'eva sattamaṃ.
so rūpaṃ viññāṇaṃ upeti upādiyati adhiṭṭhāti attā me'ti. tass'ime pañc'upādānakkhandhā upetā upādinnā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti.
tass'ime dhammā aññam'aññaṃ vipaccanīkā gahitā dīgharattaṃ ahitāya dukkhāya saṃvattanti kodh'ābhibhūtassa.

30189.meaning1: when he (is seeing rise and fall) in these

examples.text: tass'imesu pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu udayabbay'ānupassino viharato yo'pi'ssa hoti pañcasu upādānakkhandhesu anusahagato asmī'ti, māno asmī'ti, chando asmī'ti anusayo asamūhato, so'pi samugghātaṃ gacchati.

30190.meaning1: for that one here; for whom here

examples.text: sīm'ātigo brāhmaṇo tassa n'atthi, ñatvā va disvā va samuggahītaṃ, na rāgarāgī na virāgaratto, tass'īdha n'atthī param'uggahītan'ti.
tass'īdha diṭṭhe va sute mute vā, pakappitā n'atthi aṇū'pi saññā, taṃ brāhmaṇaṃ diṭṭhim'anādiyānaṃ, ken'īdha lokasmiṃ vikappayeyya.
addasā kho sakko devānam'indo bhagavantaṃ magadhesu viharantaṃ pācīnato rājagahassa ambasaṇḍā nāma brāhmaṇagāmo, tass'uttarato vediyake pabbate indasālaguhāyaṃ.

30192.meaning1: summary; a short verse given at the end of each vagga listing the titles or topics of the relevant suttas

examples.text: tass'uddānaṃ moḷiyaphaggun'ariṭṭhañ'ca nāmo, andhavane kathipuṇṇaṃ nivāpo, rāsi-kaṇeru-mahāgajanāmo, sār'ūpamo puna piṅgalakoccho.
tass'uddānaṃ kandara-nāgara-sekhavato ca, potaliyo puna jīvakabhacco, upālidamatho kukkurābhayo, bahuvedanīy'āpaṇṇakato dasamo.

tatr'āvuso, yv'āyaṃ puggalo sāṅgaṇo'va samāno atthi me ajjhattaṃ aṅgaṇan'ti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti, tass'etaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ, na chandaṃ janessati na vāyamissati na vīriyaṃ ārabhissati tass'aṅgaṇassa pahānāya
tass'esā bhoto gotamassa seyyā paññattā'ti.

30195.meaning1: just for him; even for him; just that alone

examples.text: tass'eva tena pāpiyo, yo kuddhaṃ paṭikujjhati, kuddhaṃ appaṭikujjhanto, saṅgāmaṃ jeti dujjayaṃ.
tass'eva kho pana pubbe aviddasuno abhijjhā hoti chando sārāgo. sv'āssa pahīno hoti ucchinnamūlo tāl'āvatthukato anabhāvaṃkato āyatiṃ anuppādadhammo.

30196.meaning1: of that very; of that exact; of the same

examples.text: tass'eva sukhavedaniyassa phassassa nirodhā yaṃ tajjaṃ vedayitaṃ sukhavedaniyaṃ phassaṃ paṭicca uppannā sukhā vedanā sā nirujjhati, sā vūpasammatī'ti pajānāti.
seyyathā'pi, poṭṭhapāda, puriso nisseṇiṃ kareyya pāsādassa ārohaṇāya tass'eva pāsādassa heṭṭhā.

30197.commentary: (ANa) na tass'evan'ti maññare'ti mayaṃ evaṃsantā evaṃsabhāvā'ti tassa na maññare, na maññantī'ti attho.

examples.text: avijjānivutā posā, andhabhūtā acakkhukā, yathā dhammā tathā santā, na tass'evan'ti maññare'ti.
